decisions.reason: As a multi-item facial-care line close to the core range with a highly visible launch and two years of commitment behind it, management is very likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course now.

The serum remains close to the established natural skincare offer and, having already absorbed development and launch effort in a growing market, is likely to be retained unless results clearly deteriorate.

Although less visibly committed than Product A, the cleansing oil is a very recent addition within the core facial-care category, so management would probably treat any weak early signals as temporary and keep it for another year.
